speak: A systematic review starts with a list: every paper that could be included, before any screening begins.
en:
A systematic review starts with a list:
every paper that could be included.
pt:
Uma revisão sistemática começa com uma lista:
todo artigo que poderia entrar.

speak: That list moves. Same declared scope, one month apart: four hundred and twenty-seven more papers, because an index caught up with a conference.
en:
That list moves. Same scope, one month apart:
427 more papers.
pt:
Essa lista muda. Mesmo escopo, um mês depois:
427 artigos a mais.

speak: Anyone who ran the search again got a different list, with no way to show which one they had used.
en:
Run the search again and you get another list,
with no way to show which one you used.
pt:
Refaça a busca e vem outra lista,
sem poder mostrar qual delas você usou.

speak: TopVenues turns that list into a file. You declare the venues and the years. It builds the list once, freezes it, and ships the query with it.
en:
TopVenues turns that list into a file:
declare, build once, freeze, ship the query.
pt:
O TopVenues transforma essa lista num arquivo:
declarar, construir, congelar, entregar a consulta.

speak: One program, reading one file. Identity comes from DBLP. The abstracts come from open APIs, and from publisher pages only for what is left.
en:
One program, one file. Identity from DBLP,
abstracts from open APIs and publisher pages.
pt:
Um programa, um arquivo. Identidade do DBLP,
resumos de APIs abertas e das editoras.

speak: Start where a reviewer starts. A fresh clone, and one command.
en:
Start where a reviewer starts:
a fresh clone, and one command.
pt:
Comece onde o revisor começa:
um clone novo e um comando.

speak: It restores the corpus from the frozen file, checks the fingerprint against the manifest, runs the tests, and searches.
en:
It restores the corpus, checks the fingerprint,
runs the tests, and searches.
pt:
Ele restaura o corpus, confere a impressão digital,
roda os testes e busca.

speak: The whole test suite, in eight environments, on every change. The same bytes every time.
en:
The whole suite, eight environments, every change.
The same bytes every time.
pt:
A suíte inteira, oito ambientes, a cada mudança.
Sempre os mesmos bytes.

speak: Now the questions. Fifteen thousand, two hundred and eighty-six papers. Twenty declared venues. Two thousand nineteen to two thousand twenty-six.
en:
Now the questions: 15,286 papers,
20 declared venues, 2019 to 2026.
pt:
Agora as perguntas: 15.286 artigos,
20 veículos declarados, de 2019 a 2026.

speak: Search happens inside the file. A text index finds the papers, a relevance formula ranks them. No internet. No model.
en:
Search happens inside the file: an index finds,
a relevance formula ranks. No internet, no model.
pt:
A busca acontece dentro do arquivo: um índice acha,
uma fórmula ordena. Sem internet e sem modelo.

speak: The scope is stated above the results, so a reader knows what was searched, not just what was found.
en:
The scope is stated above the results:
what was searched, not just what was found.
pt:
O escopo aparece acima dos resultados:
o que foi buscado, não só o que foi achado.

speak: The same query runs on the command line, and exports BibTeX you can paste straight into the paper.
en:
The same query on the command line,
with BibTeX you can paste into the paper.
pt:
A mesma consulta na linha de comando,
com BibTeX para colar direto no artigo.

speak: It also says where it is silent. Eight hundred and ninety-two records carry no abstract, and the gap is declared source by source.
en:
It also says where it is silent: 892 records
carry no abstract, declared source by source.
pt:
Ele também diz onde se cala: 892 registros
sem resumo, declarados fonte por fonte.

speak: With the list fixed, things become measurable. Three in ten top-four papers were already public on arXiv, a median of five months earlier.
en:
With the list fixed, things become measurable:
3 in 10 top-4 papers were already on arXiv.
pt:
Com a lista fixa, dá para medir:
3 em cada 10 artigos do top-4 já estavam no arXiv.

speak: And one question — has any author published at these venues before — separates preprints by sixteen and a half times. Replicated on a second cohort.
en:
One question separates preprints by 16.5×,
replicated on a second cohort.
pt:
Uma pergunta separa preprints em 16,5×,
replicado numa segunda coorte.

speak: Declare the list. Freeze it. Cite it. The code, the corpus and the papers are open.
en:
Declare the list. Freeze it. Cite it.
Code, corpus and papers are open.
pt:
Declare a lista. Congele. Cite.
Código, corpus e artigos estão abertos.
